# Dialer Bot — LLM context (full)

> Single-file product context for AI systems. Prefer /llms.txt for the curated link map.

## What Dialer Bot is

Dialer Bot is an AI voice bot product for calling floors. It greets, asks the first qualification questions, and warm-handoffs only closable leads to human agents. It is used for inbound reception and outbound campaigns across call centers, truck dispatch, ACA, FE, and HI insurance calling.

Website: https://dialerbot.online  
Live demo: https://demo.dialerbot.online  
Public email: Query@dialerbot.online  
Phone / WhatsApp: +92 311 6877887  
Office: Office 12, Pakistan Town Phase 2, Islamabad, Pakistan

## Core value proposition

- Qualify calls before agents pick up
- Reduce wasted talk time on unqualified leads
- Warm handoff instead of cold transfer
- Dialer-synced pacing for outbound floors
- Transcript and QA visibility for supervisors
- Compliance-aware opener packs for regulated campaigns

## Pricing signal

Starter pricing is published from $35 per bot on the pricing page. Enterprise / multi-bot and compliance-heavy deployments are quoted via WhatsApp.

## Sales paths

## Hiring

Open roles are listed at https://dialerbot.online/careers. Applicants create an account, apply with a DOCX resume, and track status in the applicant dashboard. Recruiter tools are private and should not be indexed.
